issues.description: Default change from EXTERNAL to FIXED is a silent breaking change to turn-detection semantics
issues.detail: Existing callers who relied on the documented EXTERNAL default now get FIXED behavior with no migration note. The changelog labels it 'added/fixed' but the InputParams default and TurnDetectionMode docstring both flip meaning. State the invariant for callers: which mode emits VAD frames, which delegates to Pipecat. Without that, downstream pipelines silently change frame topology.

issues.description: _enable_vad predicate compares TurnDetectionMode values against EndOfUtteranceMode enum members
issues.detail: Line 334 checks self._config.end_of_utterance_mode against EndOfUtteranceMode.FIXED/EXTERNAL, but the user-facing knob is turn_detection_mode (TurnDetectionMode). Unless _config maps one to the other identically, the predicate is asymptotically fine but practically wrong: FIXED on the user side may not disable VAD as advertised. Audit the mapping and state it in a comment; this is the load-bearing invariant of the whole PR.

issues.description: split_sentences handling conflates None and False at the config boundary
issues.detail: params.split_sentences is typed Optional[bool] but `params.split_sentences or False` collapses None into False unconditionally, overriding any server-side default for emit_sentences. If the SDK distinguishes 'unset' from 'explicit False', this PR removes that distinction. Either pass through None or document that False is the intended floor.

issues.description: Frame-type swap from UserStoppedSpeakingFrame to VADUserStoppedSpeakingFrame lacks a stated invariant
issues.detail: The finalize path now only fires on VADUserStoppedSpeakingFrame. The reader must trust that this frame is emitted in every mode that should trigger finalize and never in the modes where the engine handles its own endpointing. A two-line comment naming that invariant (which producer emits it, when _enable_vad is true vs false) would make this literate; currently it is tried-correct, not proved-correct.

issues.description: Commented-out start_processing_metrics line should be removed or restored, not shuffled
issues.detail: The diff moves `# await self.start_processing_metrics()` from after the broadcast to before it, but it remains commented out. Either metrics start at StartOfTurn (uncomment) or they do not (delete). Leaving dead code with reordered position invites cargo-cult preservation by the next reader.

review.summary: The PR is small and the intent is sensible: align with Speechmatics 0.0.99 by adding a FIXED mode and listening for VADUserStoppedSpeakingFrame. The rigor gap is that the load-bearing invariant — when VAD is internal vs external and which frame finalizes the turn — is never stated in the code, and the predicate at line 334 mixes TurnDetectionMode and EndOfUtteranceMode enums in a way that needs an explicit audit. Changing the default from EXTERNAL to FIXED is a behavioral break worth calling out in migration notes. Verdict: UNDER-AUDITED and NEEDS-LITERATE-COMMENT; correctness likely fine but the next reader is operating on faith.
